newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka exchange to be fully automated in May.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka exchange to be fully automated in May.

text.p: Trading on the Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) will become fully automated next month, a senior exchange official said on Wednesday.
"We hope to have fully screen-based trading in May which will make us a fully automated stock exchange," Isuru Tillakawardana, assistant general manager of the exchange told Reuters.
Brokers will initially trade through computer terminals on the floor and an electronic data wall will display market information.

"Within three to four months floor trading will cease to exist on a regular basis, and only be used as a back up if there is a wide area network failure," Lalin Paranavitana, Manager of Data Processing said.
The CSE now has an open outcry trading system. Back office settlement operations were automated earlier by putting in place a central depository system.
